name: feature-theater
description: OVERDRIVE runs each feature in an isolated repository clone and orchestrates the lane workers, with durable specs, live steering, executed verification, and an inline work graph.

interface.shortDescription: Isolated feature clones, orchestrated from Codex.
interface.longDescription: OVERDRIVE develops a repository through isolated feature clones orchestrated from one conversation. Adopt a repository or begin a managed project from scratch; every feature lane gets its own full clone, durable spec, and context packet. The coordinator refines specs, dispatches and steers lane workers, and checkpoints context. A native work graph shows dependencies, progress, and blockers; all interaction stays in the existing conversation. Required checks execute against exact commits and the current feature contract before a lane is accepted.
defaultPrompt: Set up OVERDRIVE for this repository.
Start a managed project from a product brief.
Create a feature lane and refine its spec.
Show this feature's work graph and what is blocked.
